## Claim amendment · design point 2 · 2026-11-16T04:38Z

Ruling: **B**. Claim 6907429999's file surface widens: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/cli.ts` may also write the supplied template's file name and sha256 into the run record (a new top-level `template` key beside `env`, set after `runRecord`), in addition to adding the subcommand. No `orchestrate.ts` or `scorecard.ts` change.

Why: an ask-mode or template-mode record names its build only as `ModeRun.template.source = "supplied template"`, so two different supplied builds would sum into one cell, and eval#1's M2 cross matrix runs exactly that shape (two fixed templates, each asked by several models). The summary rows ask and template records by that hash, labelled by file name. A record without the key (eval#1's close-out runs are pinned at `31eb2aed`) falls back to one row per record file, never summed with another. The exporter's record parse is `looseObject` at the top level, so the new key passes; pin that the gallery export of a record carrying it is unchanged. The new record field is one more `Clause-②: yes (widening)` item.

Also accepted as the thread proposed: one table per card × mode; prompt choice, package source, ask repeats and driver must agree within a table, else that table is refused naming the difference and the files on each side (exit 1, other tables still print); recorded effort joins the served model in the axis label; cells count the first build and Run half with Iterate rows as the scorecard shows them; ask cost and time from the per-mode `askSpend`; `--card` and `--mode` filters.

## Landed · 2026-11-16T06:16Z

PR #34310 merged as `b2e26fe1` (ACCEPT 6908455205; contract review PASS 6908107479). `objectstack-scenarios summary <record.json|dir>…` reads run records only (no model, no network) and prints one author-model × ask-model table per card and mode, with `--card` / `--mode` filters; a table whose runs differ in prompt choice, package source, ask repeats or driver is refused with each difference named (exit 1, other tables still print). Per ruling B (6907482043), `run --template F` now writes a top-level `template: { file, sha256 }` key so runs on one supplied build group together; a record without the key is its own row. A run without `--template` writes the same record as before. `pm:dispatched` dropped; card thread closing.
